theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Real Estate (+1.74%) and Materials (+0.79%) led the market today, while Energy (-0.61%) and Technology (-0.32%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.05% versus +0.49% for defensives and +0.64% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained -0.68% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -1.72%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.90%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 1.66% to 16.61, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.65% to $4,024.70, crude oil was little changed at $101.99, and bitcoin slipped 0.72% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
